note: Key players FPL Weekly follows every week. Mentions on the page are found automatically: every news item whose title, text or background contains one of a player's names. Names are matched case-sensitively as whole words.

groups.title: Big software platforms
groups.lead: The companies whose software most planning and construction data passes through.

players.name: Autodesk
players.what: Maker of Revit, AutoCAD and Civil 3D and of Autodesk Construction Cloud, the most widely used design software in building.

players.name: Bentley Systems
players.what: Infrastructure software for roads, rail, bridges and utilities (MicroStation, OpenRoads, iTwin digital twins); owns the 3D geodata platform Cesium.

players.name: Trimble
players.what: Surveying instruments, machine control and software such as Tekla, SketchUp and the common data environment Trimble Connect.

players.name: Nemetschek Group
players.what: Munich-based group behind Allplan, Graphisoft (Archicad), Bluebeam, SCIA, FRILO and the model checker Solibri.

players.name: Procore
players.what: Cloud platform for construction project management: documents, RFIs, change orders, budgets and site reports.

players.name: Hexagon
players.what: Measurement technology group; its Leica Geosystems brand makes laser scanners and survey instruments used on many sites.

groups.title: Structural software (DACH)
groups.lead: The analysis and design programs that civil engineers in Switzerland, Germany and Austria use every day.

players.name: Dlubal Software
players.what: Finite-element programs RFEM and RSTAB for the structural analysis and design of buildings and bridges.

players.name: SOFiSTiK
players.what: Finite-element software for bridges and complex structures, with close integration into Revit.

players.name: cubus
players.what: Zurich-based maker of structural software such as CEDRUS and STATIK, widely used in Swiss engineering offices.

groups.title: AI for project knowledge
groups.lead: Young companies that use AI to make a project's documents searchable and answerable.

players.name: Stoa
players.what: Helsinki start-up whose AI reads a construction project's documents and answers questions with citations to the source.

groups.title: Switzerland
groups.lead: Standards bodies, research, clients and builders that shape digital construction in Switzerland.

players.name: SIA
players.what: Swiss society of engineers and architects; publishes the Swiss construction standards and the phase model most projects follow.

players.name: Bauen digital Schweiz / buildingSMART Switzerland
players.what: The Swiss chapter of buildingSMART; promotes open BIM standards such as IFC and guidelines for digital collaboration.

players.name: NCCR Digital Fabrication (ETH Zurich)
players.what: National research centre led by ETH Zurich on robotics, 3D printing and digital fabrication in architecture and construction.

players.name: Implenia
players.what: Switzerland's largest construction and civil engineering company, also active in Germany, Austria and Scandinavia.

players.name: BKW
players.what: Bern-based energy and infrastructure group that has built up one of the largest engineering and planning networks in Europe.

players.name: SBB
players.what: Swiss Federal Railways, one of the country's largest clients for construction and owner of a large rail infrastructure.

players.name: ASTRA (Federal Roads Office)
players.what: Swiss Federal Roads Office; builds, operates and maintains the national motorway network.
